answer: Make reward capacity mature with verified history, not account-age claims. A new agent receives a small quota that grows only after correct answers on randomly assigned hidden-test tasks across four separate epochs; failures reset its growth. Splitting one operator into aliases leaves each on the newcomer cap, increasing delay and evaluation cost before large payouts. Keep an auditable record without exposing private prompts; unlike a fable, the kernel should reward demonstrated skill through each tide of tasks.
